assets.name: fairy_paving
assets.prompt: Create one original seamless tileable square albedo texture for a premium stylized fairytale 3D racing game's village road. Orthographic top-down view, flat diffuse neutral lighting, no perspective or directional baked shadow. Small irregular softly rounded worn limestone cobblestones, warm pale ivory, honey cream, blush sandstone and a few very subtle lavender-gray stones, laid in loosely staggered rows, narrow muted sandy joints with tiny occasional moss traces. Rich refined hand-painted surface detail, gentle stone grain and worn edges, charming storybook art, calm readable color variation, NOT dark brown dirt and NOT wood. Surface fills the canvas edge to edge and tiles convincingly in both directions with consistent scale. No large plants, props, scenery, border, text, labels, logos, or watermark. Maximum available native resolution, ideally 2048 square.

assets.name: fairy_masonry
assets.prompt: Create one original seamless tileable square albedo texture for richly detailed stylized fairytale castle and bridge masonry in a 3D game. Front orthographic surface view, flat neutral diffuse lighting, no perspective and no directional baked shadows. Softly dressed warm ivory limestone blocks in varied but harmonious sizes, rounded worn edges, pale cream and light warm-gray faces, slender sandy mortar joints, restrained sage moss and tiny age marks along some joints. Elegant welcoming storybook castle, refined painterly material detail with calm large forms and subtle grain, not photoreal rubble, not wood and not a flat cartoon grid. Full-bleed texture with visually seamless matching edges in both directions. No architecture scene, windows, plants growing out of the wall, objects, text, labels, border or watermark. Maximum available native resolution, ideally 2048 square.

assets.name: fairy_roof
assets.prompt: Create one original seamless tileable square albedo texture for the curved roofs of a premium stylized fairytale 3D village. Orthographic close surface view, flat neutral illumination with no perspective and no directional baked shadow. Neatly overlapping slightly irregular rounded scallop ceramic roof shingles, small elegant scale, soft beveled worn rims, hand-painted material grain and very restrained lichen specks. Use light desaturated warm gray/lavender values so the game can tint the tiles blue, lilac, rose and terracotta without muddy colors. Rich refined storybook painted detail, gentle value variation, not wood planks, not metal and not giant roof blocks. Fill the canvas completely and tile in both directions with matching scale. No whole house, sky, objects, text, logos, labels, border or watermark. Maximum available native resolution, ideally 2048 square.

assets.name: wisteria_blossoms
assets.prompt: Create one original botanical foliage cutout asset for a beautifully detailed stylized fairytale 3D garden. One natural slender curved wisteria twig with five long gracefully hanging racemes of small lavender, violet and soft blush lilac blossoms, accompanied by a few rich green compound leaves near the top. All five distinct hanging flower clusters fully visible, a pleasing loose asymmetrical arrangement, entire sprig framed with a small clear margin. High-end hand-painted 3D game foliage appearance, exquisite tiny petals and refined botanical shapes, soft diffuse neutral lighting without dramatic baked shadows. TRUE transparent alpha background around and between all blossoms and stems. Mostly frontal view suitable for alpha-cutout foliage cards; no pot, background, ground, separate cast shadow, text, border, checkerboard or watermark. Maximum available native quality, ideally 2048 square.
